title: Handles witness signing of p2pk proofs according to NUT-11
body:
## Description

Handles mutisig witness signing according to NUT-11.

Related PR: https://github.com/cashubtc/cashu-ts/pull/284

## Changes

- Adds new `getP2PExpectedKWitnessPubkeys` function which gets the expected witnesses for proofs according to the p2pk secret tags.
- Adjusts `getSignedProofs` function so it signs all expected witnesses that it has pks for
- Adjusts `getSignedProof` to allow multiple witnesses to sign

title: NUT11 sign outputs
body:
# Fixes: [this issue](https://github.com/cashubtc/cashu.me/issues/186)

## Description
Adding support for signing the outputs when needed. This is a step towards `SIG_ALL` implementation and a fix for issues when trying to redeem `SIG_ALL` tokens on cashu.me and others that use cashu-ts behind the scenes. With this functionality we can then instruct cashu-ts to sign the outputs when it finds `SIG_ALL` tags.

## Changes

- added `signBlindedMessage`, `getSignedOutput`, `getSignedOutputs`
- introduced a new optional field `witness` in `BlindedMessage`
- modified `createRandomBlindedMessage` and `blindMessage` to allow a private key to be specified as input and act accordingly.
- npm run format

title: NUT-12 tools for DLEQ verification
body:
## Description
Implementing NUT-12 cryptography

## Changes
- `createDLEQProof`: creates a DLEQ proof for the given ecash blind message and signature.
- `verifyDLEQProof`: verifies the DLEQ proof.
- `verifyDLEQProof_reblind`: re-blinds the unblinded ecash signature and message with the given blinding factor.

> [!WARNING] 
> `createDLEQProof` operates on raw secrets, which are converted to BigInt.
> BigInt does not support constant time addition or constant time modular multiplication.
> Therefore, this function should only be used for testing the verification functions and be disabled in production until we sort it out.
